site.title: KV Toolkit
site.author: KV
site.headline: Tools that bridge Power Platform’s gaps.
site.intro: Browser bookmarklets, platform controls and developer utilities.
site.description: Bookmarklets and tools for Dynamics 365, Dataverse and Power Apps by KV. Drag a button onto your favourites bar to install a tool.
site.disclaimer: Personal projects by KV, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. Dynamics 365, Dataverse and Power Apps are trademarks of Microsoft.

DynamicsTranslator.name: Dynamics Translator
DynamicsTranslator.tagline: Edit labels where they appear in Dynamics 365 and Power Apps, or work in bulk with an Excel-style translation workbench.

image.alt: Dynamics Translator marking the labels of a Project record, with a field's translation popup open

UnmanagedLayerScanner.name: Unmanaged Layer Scanner
UnmanagedLayerScanner.tagline: Find unmanaged layers over managed components, compare their changes, and remove selected active customizations.

image.alt: Unmanaged Layer Scanner listing components with an unmanaged layer

SQLAdvancedFind.name: SQL Advanced Find
SQLAdvancedFind.tagline: Query, explore, and edit Dataverse data with SQL inside your existing browser session.
SQLAdvancedFind.credit: SQL Advanced Find is inspired by SQL 4 CDS by Mark Carrington and bundles Preact (MIT License).

image.alt: SQL Advanced Find: a SQL query and its results in an editable grid

LevelUpBookmarklet.name: Level Up Bookmarklet
LevelUpBookmarklet.tagline: Familiar Level Up developer tools in a browser bookmark, with additional Power Platform utilities.
LevelUpBookmarklet.credit: Level Up Bookmarklet is based on Level Up for Dynamics 365 / Power Apps by Natraj Yegnaraman and its contributors (MIT License). It is not the official Level Up project.

image.alt: The Level Up sidebar in a Dynamics 365 form

NToNMultiSelect.name: N:N Multi-Select
NToNMultiSelect.tagline: A native-feeling picker for Dataverse many-to-many relationships. Search, select, and save immediately.

image.alt: N:N Multi-Select on a model-driven form

DataverseImpersonator.name: Dataverse Impersonator
DataverseImpersonator.tagline: Test model-driven apps under another user's Dataverse security context in an isolated desktop window.

image.alt: Dataverse Impersonator: a model-driven app opened as another user
